programme.title: The Man Flying Around The World In a Hydrogen Plane!

programme.title: The Winter Olympic Games Legacy | Milano Cortina 2026
programme.desc: The Milano Cortina 2026 Winter Olympic Games are transforming Northern Italy—and what they're leaving behind will last for generations.We spent a week on the ground exploring the Olympic legacy in action: an Olympic Village becoming homes for 1,700 students, mountain towns getting critical infrastructure upgrades, and accessibility improvements that will serve communities for decades.

programme.title: The Paris Olympic Village: One Year On
programme.desc: We revisited the Olympic Village one year after this Paris 2024 Olympic Games.This is how the Olympic legacy has transformed an entire community!We've visited this Olympic Village twice before—once just before the games, and again right after they ended.

programme.title: Every Building in 2050 Will Be Covered in MOSS!
programme.desc: This is why moss is the future of sustainable architecture!Alive Labs in London, are growing moss panels that can be installed in cities to help remove air pollution, suck up carbon dioxide, regulate the temperature and absorb rainwater!

programme.title: Mistakes Can Happen At Any Time On Site
programme.desc: This video documents my first-ever cabinet installation for a paying client — from cutting melamine sheets in the workshop to scribing fillers on site and figuring things out the hard way.

programme.title: The Most Expensive Plywood I've Ever Worked With
programme.desc: I’m building a custom L-shaped shoe rack using premium Tasmanian Oak veneered plywood with a solid Victorian Ash seat.This project was a great client commission and a fun build, but with timber prices skyrocketing—and Victorian Ash becoming harder to source after the 2023 logging ban—it definitely pushed the limits of my margins.

programme.title: Is The Laser Industry Evolving Quick Enough?
programme.desc: The laser engraving world is exploding — but has it evolved too fast for beginners to keep up?In this video, I dive into my experience setting up the Omtech Turbo 756 60W CO₂ laser, from the initial unboxing to the unexpected issues that exposed some growing pains in the laser industry.

programme.title: The Most Beautiful Desk I've Ever Built
programme.desc: Ever thought about making a desk out of end grain?In this video, I take the idea of end grain parquet flooring and flip it on its head — turning it into a custom end grain desk build made entirely from timber offcuts.

programme.title: MINITUNS

programme.title: Papelitos

programme.title: BFF
